caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted object in the shape of an eagle with outstretched wings. The eagle has detailed feather patterns on its wings and body, with its head facing to the right. Attached to the top of each wing is a cylindrical tube angled outward. There is another cylindrical object located below the eagle’s tail, with a curved rod extending from each lower wing and joining in a loop to the bottom cylinder. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray on a beige background, with the artist’s signature “H. BADER” in the lower right corner. The image is enclosed within a single-line rectangular border.
title: Swing Torch
